facts.text: Every admitted undergraduate student at Olin College of Engineering receives an institutional merit scholarship that covers a significant portion of tuition costs.

sources.title: Admission + Financial Aid | Olin College of Engineering | Olin ...
sources.quote: To demonstrate this commitment, every student admitted to Olin receives a merit-based tuition scholarship. Additionally, we meet each student's full demonstrated financial need, ensuring that finances won't stand in the way of your education.
